title: Trusted source-layout compatibility prerequisite
objective: Prepare and publish a separately reviewed old-layout prerequisite on main so a future base-owned validator can validate PR18's new source layout without weakening existing trust or consumer contracts.
approved_sources: User request 2026-10-20 to correct PR18 Copilot omissions and red checks; prerequisite publication is necessary to resolve the base-owned layout incompatibility.
AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md and policy/core.md at the recorded base.
PR18 frozen published snapshot c50108773ba3195bf0f7503e5dffb2d7bfc78cd3 and its independent layout review evidence.

exclude: Schema, core invariant or dependency version changes
Native permission or provider activation changes
PR18 implementation worktree and external repositories

acceptance.description: The prerequisite preserves the old repository layout and exact core invariants, dependency pins, existing historical fixtures and native permission contracts.

Source-only layout resolution independently handles old/new candidate and trusted-base roots while rejecting ambiguous, missing, mixed or aliased canonical authorities without falling back to consumer mode.

The actual previous main validator accepts this prerequisite at its old paths, and the prerequisite trusted validator accepts the exact frozen PR18 new-layout candidate against the old-layout trusted base.
Policy, schema, adapter, permission, dependency and historical-map/hash negative cases remain rejecting; new named task/review artifacts are validated by trusted schemas.

All original 418 test methods/assertions and immutable fixtures remain; affected and complete suites, compilers, source dependency checks and committed-patch whitespace checks pass with actual environment/runtime limits recorded.
Independent plan review, quality checks, two frozen Full reviews, separate triage and any necessary Delta are recorded against exact revisions and patch digests.
A separate prerequisite PR targets main with verified remote tree/check state and explicit human-merge-then-update-PR18 ordering; no merge, release, deployment or downstream activation occurs.

manual_evidence: Independent read-only plan review before implementation.
Exact old-main-to-prerequisite and prerequisite-to-frozen-new-layout transition checks without projection or candidate execution.
Negative authority, schema, history, permission and dependency regressions, with original consumer/upgrade retention.
Actual container/native CI evidence for this prerequisite or explicit pending/unexecuted status.
Two independent Full reviewers on one immutable base/head/tree/patch, separate triage and necessary bounded Delta.
Published prerequisite URL, verified remote tree/check states and explicit human merge before PR18 integration.

stop_conditions: Failed required check without diagnosed and documented disposition.
Unresolved confirmed review finding before a readiness claim.
Scope/authorization conflict or weakened trust, policy, assertions, permissions or gates.
Ambiguous source authority, unexpected overwrite, changed historical bytes or unreviewed candidate fallback.
Two Full rounds or six implementation iterations exhausted without accepted bounded closeout.
Human prerequisite merge has not occurred: do not claim PR18 trusted-base acceptance on main.
forbidden_actions: Release, deploy, change repository access/settings or activate integrations.
Candidate validator fallback, candidate-controlled historical authority, path projection, catch-and-pass or skipped required gates.
Automatic downstream application or changes to external repositories.
Force push, destructive cleanup or rewriting original historical evidence.
Claiming prior PR18 or simulated results prove this prerequisite passed remote checks, native model behavior or OS isolation.
